preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge vertices must be within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of two space-separated integers t and w.
The minimum number of edges t must be non-negative.
The number of ways w must be at least 1.
